description: Guarantees full session capture and backend trace propagation for every session of the bitdrift-shop-opentelemetry iOS demo app (ai.bitdrift.oteldemo.ios), scoped to that app ID only. Without this, `isTracingActive` stays false for every session, so the SDK never injects trace headers or exports OTel spans (basic screen-view/log capture happens regardless). Fires on a Welcome-screen SCREEN_VIEW rather than APP_LAUNCH -- the app calls Logger.startNewSession() to start a fresh session per shopping journey (both the 'Start New Journey' button and each automated Sim 5/10 run), and every one of those transitions returns to the Welcome screen, but none of them re-fire APP_LAUNCH (a cold-process-start event only). No sampling and no additional match conditions, so it captures 100% of sessions for this app; it is not narrowed to a single device.
